name: Grok Bot
author: Hector Marquez
description: Grok Bot's face in the Omarchy bar: it thinks while your agents work, perks up and names the agent that needs you, and opens a panel of every agent with what it last said.

barWidget.description: An expressive face that shows when agents are working or waiting on you, with a panel of agents and quick actions.

schema.label: Show the waiting agent's name next to the face
Nudge every (seconds) while an agent waits
schema.description: 0 nudges once when the agent starts waiting and then holds still.

schema.label: Seconds of silence before a working agent counts as idle
schema.description: Working is inferred from Grok Bot rewriting the agent's transcript; this is how long after the last write the face keeps thinking.

schema.label: Hide the face when Grok Bot is not installed
